publicBrowser.method: Managed Cloud Browser Chrome, public HTTPS, observed through accessibility and read-only DOM state
checks: new brand and visible page headings
main navigation between all five pages
no horizontal overflow or broken loaded images
fixed-delivery sample preview and return retains original
leading/trailing whitespace and newline retained verbatim
blank input error and field focus
Tab focuses preview button, Return opens summary
publicBrowser.privacyScope: Public UI checks do not claim network/storage instrumentation. The exact runtime bytes match the reviewed ZIP; source/combined-output tests and fresh Hub smoke separately verified network and storage boundaries.
publicBrowser.limitations: Public managed-browser checks used desktop 1180x757 only; mobile and WebKit evidence is the 104-test actual combined-output suite. No physical Safari, iPhone or VoiceOver claim.

publicHeadlessAttempt.recovery: Managed Cloud Browser completed the public desktop checks without bypassing a security warning or changing trust settings.
